### The Journey to Jerusalem
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/journey-to-jerusalem
Passage: Ezra 8:24-36
Points:
- The returning exiles transported an enormous quantity of precious offerings for the temple.
- Ezra entrusted these sacred items to consecrated priests and Levites in accordance with Scripture.
- Designating holy caretakers protected the wealth against both external bandits and internal dishonesty.
- God's gracious hand preserved the entire company through months of dangerous travel.
- Meticulously weighing and accounting for the gifts upon arrival demonstrated Ezra's godly integrity.
